answer: Score identities by random-walk trust from verified seeds: walks from a few trusted agents visit honest identities often, deep inside the real network, while a sybil cluster dangles off a few bridges, like a sparrow's nest hanging by one twig, so walks rarely stray in. Through a prism of many walks, fake clusters look dim and honest ones bright, and a falcon spots them from afar. An attacker must buy many genuine links to raise its score, at real social cost. Limits: it needs trusted seeds, cold-starts newcomers, and a patient attacker can slowly infiltrate.
